comments.body: Defeating any of 3 Grande Ganadors described above

wiki:
Obtainable as a random drop from these Grande Ganadors:

Season 1 (7 Wonders Chapter 2.5 Olympia)

1. Henry Every
2. Mohri Motonari
3. Peter the Great

Logbooks are used to create various items at Treasure Inspector and Inspector's Assistant in Ganador Command Center.

Recipes are still being added to the DB; one example of logbook crafted items can be found here: Sea Conquerors' Secret Treasure (No.1)

Season 1: Distant Sea's Logbook (7 Wonders CH 2.5)
Season 2: Sailor's Journal of the Polar Sea (7 Wonders CH 2.75)
Season 3: Wonder Sea's Logbook (7 Wonders CH 3.1 Espada)
Season 4: Deep Blue Sea's Logbook (7 Wonders CH 3.3 Black Bart)
